note_en: Golden corpus for issue #10 / docs/04-metrics.md. Files are managed exactly as obtained (no resampling/normalization). This set must not change without an ADR (see docs/adr/0004-golden-corpus.md).
diversity_methodology: attack: attack_rise_ms <= 100 -> 'sharp', otherwise 'soft'. pitch: pitch_strength >= 0.5 -> 'yes', otherwise 'no'. harmonic_motion: centroid_motion_ratio > 0.4 -> 'dynamic', otherwise 'static'. These thresholds are a corpus-curation convention for this manifest only; they are NOT the metrics harness's own segment boundaries or thresholds (those remain open, see docs/06-open-questions.md Q-002/Q-004).

preset_path_note_en: preset_path (added in schema_version 1.2.0, P1-07 #52): the path to a preset JSON used to render each entry's candidate. Phase 1 has no automated fitting yet, so most entries still share the same preliminary provisional preset (corpus/presets/provisional_v0.json) that renders silence (the engine's DSP is not fitted to any target, docs/02). The exception is spoken_hello, which P1-12 (#57) points at a hand-written preset (corpus/presets/spoken_hello_manual_v1.json) exercising all four v0 layers plus the modulation matrix, to satisfy the phase-1 transition condition ('render a golden source from a manual preset'). harness/corpus_runner.py invokes luthier-render with each entry's preset at the target's sample rate, then computes metrics against the rendered WAV. The sample-rate policy is recorded in the output vector's calc_conditions.render.sr_mismatch_policy (see docs/04-metrics.schema.json). The former self-comparison seam candidate_path is removed.
